**The Absolutely Wonderful "Worst" Features of Each US State**

**Alabama** - The state boasts an impressively enthusiastic relationship with college football that definitely doesn't result in family feuds, broken friendships, or questionable financial decisions involving game tickets!

**Alaska** - Enjoy the delightful -40°F winter temperatures that provide free cryotherapy sessions and help you truly appreciate the concept of "staying indoors for survival"!

**Arizona** - Experience the joy of 120°F summer heat that turns your car into a mobile sauna and gives you the exciting challenge of touching your steering wheel without oven mitts!

**Arkansas** - Home to the magnificent tradition of pronouncing it completely differently than Kansas, ensuring endless opportunities for linguistic debates with out-of-state visitors!

**California** - Where a modest $3,000/month gets you a charming studio apartment with the unique feature of being able to touch all four walls from your bed!

**Colorado** - Altitude sickness provides visitors with complimentary headaches and nausea, helping them save money on alcohol to achieve similar effects!

**Connecticut** - Features the most reasonably priced highway tolls that only cost slightly more than your mortgage payment to cross the state!

**Delaware** - Proudly maintains its status as "that state everyone forgets exists," providing residents with the ultimate privacy and anonymity!

**Florida** - Home to Florida Man, whose daily adventures in the news ensure you'll never run out of conversation starters or reasons to check your homeowner's insurance!

**Georgia** - The humidity creates a natural steam room effect everywhere you go, eliminating the need for expensive spa treatments or functioning hair styles!

**Hawaii** - Where the cost of milk rivals champagne prices, making every bowl of cereal feel like a luxury experience!

**Idaho** - Offers the thrilling monotony of endless potato fields, perfect for those who find varied landscapes overstimulating!

**Illinois** - Chicago's wind provides free dermabrasion services while simultaneously redistributing your personal belongings across several city blocks!

**Indiana** - The magnificent potholes offer free vehicle suspension tests and keep auto repair shops thriving in these tough economic times!

**Iowa** - Features captivating conversations about corn yields that can last for hours, ensuring you'll never suffer from awkward silences!

**Kansas** - The tornadoes provide complimentary home remodeling services and exciting opportunities to meet your basement on a more intimate level!

**Kentucky** - The bourbon culture ensures every family gathering includes the heartwarming tradition of Uncle Jerry's "honest opinions" about everyone!

**Louisiana** - The mosquitoes are so large and numerous they practically qualify as the state bird, providing year-round companionship and blood donation opportunities!

**Maine** - The black flies offer free acupuncture services all summer long, helping tourists save money on alternative medicine treatments!

**Maryland** - Old Bay seasoning on literally everything ensures you'll never have to experience the boring burden of tasting actual food!

**Massachusetts** - Rotaries (roundabouts) provide endless entertainment as drivers play a real-life game of automotive roulette!

**Michigan** - The roads offer a thrilling off-road experience without having to leave the pavement or pay for an adventure tour!

**Minnesota** - The passive-aggressive "Minnesota Nice" ensures you'll never know if someone actually likes you, adding mystery to every social interaction!

**Mississippi** - The education system rankings ensure your children won't be burdened by excessive knowledge or unrealistic career expectations!

**Missouri** - The unpredictable weather gives you the excitement of experiencing all four seasons in a single day, sometimes within the same hour!

**Montana** - The sparse population means the nearest hospital might be hours away, adding an element of extreme sports to everyday injuries!

**Nebraska** - The endless flat plains provide a humbling reminder that excitement and visual stimulation are overrated luxuries!

**Nevada** - The slot machines in grocery stores ensure you can gamble away your food budget without the inconvenience of a separate trip!

**New Hampshire** - The state motto "Live Free or Die" is taken so seriously that seatbelts remain optional, adding thrilling uncertainty to every drive!

**New Jersey** - The turnpike aroma provides a unique sensory experience that helps build character and appreciation for fresh air elsewhere!

**New Mexico** - The green chile obsession means every meal is a spicy adventure in digestive fortitude and bathroom proximity awareness!

**New York** - Times Square offers the delightful experience of being touched by strangers while paying $30 for a mediocre sandwich!

**North Carolina** - The bathroom bill debates ensure every restroom visit comes with free political commentary and social tension!

**North Dakota** - The winter winds create a natural exfoliation experience that removes both dead skin cells and the will to go outside!

**Ohio** - The weather can't decide what it wants to be, providing residents with the excitement of never knowing how to dress appropriately!

**Oklahoma** - The fracking-induced earthquakes add a thrilling element of uncertainty to home ownership and glassware collections!

**Oregon** - The rain ensures you'll never waste money on car washes or suffer from the tyranny of styled hair!

**Pennsylvania** - The liquor laws provide an exciting scavenger hunt experience every time you want to buy beer and wine in the same trip!

**Rhode Island** - Coffee milk as the state drink ensures children start their caffeine addiction early and efficiently!

**South Carolina** - The palmetto bugs (definitely not giant flying cockroaches) provide free home security by terrifying away burglars and guests alike!

**South Dakota** - The Sturgis Motorcycle Rally brings the soothing sounds of thousands of Harleys to help you appreciate silence the other 51 weeks!

**Tennessee** - Nashville's bachelorette parties on pedal taverns create moving obstacles that test everyone's patience and driving skills!

**Texas** - Everything is bigger, including the egos, ensuring you'll never suffer from an excess of humility or modest portion sizes!

**Utah** - The liquor laws make drinking an exciting puzzle game where you need a membership, food order, and pure determination to get a beer!

**Vermont** - The leaf peepers create charming traffic jams that turn 10-minute drives into 2-hour meditation sessions every fall!

**Virginia** - The blending of sweet tea boundaries creates thrilling beverage roulette at every restaurant visit!

**Washington** - The Seattle Freeze ensures you'll never be burdened by too many deep friendships or social obligations!

**West Virginia** - The mountain roads provide a roller coaster experience without the pesky safety features or admission fees!

**Wisconsin** - The cheese obsession ensures every meal includes dairy, keeping lactose intolerance counselors in steady business!

**Wyoming** - The wind is so strong it provides free relocation services for your outdoor furniture and small pets!

**Washington D.C.** - The politicians ensure you'll never run out of reasons to question your faith in humanity!
